-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #1000 / Scene #7 - Function talkevent5_1
function talkevent5_1()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town000D.map")
	MoveCamera(385.00, 207.00, 97.05)
	RotCamera(2.60, 1.25, 24.00)

	CreateObject(0, 1480, 385.00, 207.00, 128, 0, FALSE, 1, 19)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	wait(500)
	OpenTalkScene(3, 7)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(talkevent5_1)
